1479-2638-2841-3318.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2638-2841-3318.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure
Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

3280-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Croaking Counterpart, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Croaking Counterpart, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Croaking Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Croaking Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
3280-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

2034-5003-7731.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shuri, adding {C}{C}.
When Shuri dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Shuri from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Shuri enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

372-4477-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4477-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3417-7387.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to High Priest of Penance.
3417-7387.notablePrerequisites: High Priest of Penance has indestructible.
3417-7387.description:
Deal damage to High Priest of Penance.
Howlpack Avenger and High Priest of Penance trigger.
Resolve the High Priest of Penance trigger, destroying a nonland permanent.
Resolve the Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing that much damage to High Priest of Penance
Repeat from step 2.
3417-7387.notes: This loop can be repeated as often as you can deal damage to any permanent you control.

4605-4681-5147-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

813-957-7174.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second each turn.
813-957-7174.notes: You can instead cast Personify during your first extra turn, if desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-6968-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

967-3129-3809-5147-7087.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-5517-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
1978-5517-5704.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat

338-567-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-567-3197.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

186-1143-2366-2713-4552.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {0}, causing you to draw a card.
Dryad Arbor triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

7-1117-2866-6518.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-1117-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5670-5933-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-5933-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1-2275-5437-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2275-5437-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

1089-1339-6235.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Agate Instigator.
You have a way to draw a card.
1089-1339-6235.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Agate Instigator, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1306-2538-5390.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you would draw by causing each player to return a permanent to their hand instead.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to return Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

1558-3529-4231-4661.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Doppelganger is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-4661.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2034-3924-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Deep Forest Hermit that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Deep Forest Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1637-1669-3505-4423-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Plains.
Archelos is untapped.
1637-1669-3505-4423-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Thaumatog's first ability three times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains, giving Thaumatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all land cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

643-1951-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Speaker of the Heavens does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 47.
643-1951-2534.description:
Activate Speaker of the Heavens by tapping it, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying.
When the Angel enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Speaker of the Heavens.
Repeat.

1063-1633-2060-4120-4772.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

276-1633-2060-3415-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

856-1960-2882-2956.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Brandywine Farmer.
You control a Food.
Dark Privilege attached to any other creature you control.
856-1960-2882-2956.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of Brandywine Farmer due to Infinite Reflection.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Dark Privilege by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Dark Privilege ability, regenerating target creature.
Repeat for infinite Food tokens.
Activate Dark Privilege by sacrificing Brandywine Farmer.
When Brandywine Farmer dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Dark Privilege ability, regenerating target creature.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Dark Privilege by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, regenerating target creature.
Repeat from step 10.

927-1109.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, causing an opponent who controls no Islands to gain control of Skeleton Ship.
Skeleton Ship triggers, causing the opponent to sacrifice it.
However, Skeleton Ship cannot be sacrificed due to its ability granted by Jon Irenicus.
Skeleton Ship triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.
